boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Seton Hall study environments, with the relevant access or use details noted.

cards.title: Walsh Library Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Walsh Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use this second-floor computer lab when desktop software, printing, scanning, or adaptive technology will help move your work forward.
cards.short_summary: A general-use library computer lab with 55 desktops, printers, scanners, and an adaptive-technology workstation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Commons is on Walsh Library’s second floor and has 55 desktop computers, printers, scanners, copiers, and an adaptive-technology workstation.
cards.access_notes: Open for general use by the Seton Hall community during Walsh Library operating hours; eligible guests need an active guest account.

cards.entity_name: Walsh Library After Hours Study Space
cards.title: Walsh Library After Hours Study Space
cards.subtitle: Walsh Library, second floor beside Dunkin’
cards.notes: Bring your SHU ID for overnight entry and use the exterior walkway door after regular library hours.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated overnight study room with card-swipe access for current Seton Hall students.
cards.evidence_claim: During overnight hours, the room is accessible only to current SHU students via the exterior card-swipe door; the published schedule includes midnight–8 a.m. Monday through Friday.
cards.source_title: The Library’s After Hours Study Space Returns!
cards.access_notes: Published overnight access: midnight–8 a.m. Monday–Friday, midnight Friday–9 a.m. Saturday, 5 p.m. Saturday–11 a.m. Sunday, and midnight Sunday–8 a.m. Monday; current students only overnight.

cards.entity_name: Walsh Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Walsh Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Walsh Library, third floor
cards.notes: Choose the third floor for independent reading or drafting when you need a library-designated quiet-study setting.
cards.short_summary: One of Walsh Library’s two floors designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Walsh Library’s third and fourth floors are designated quiet-study floors.
cards.access_notes: Located within Walsh Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Walsh Library Fourth-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Walsh Library Fourth-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Walsh Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Set up on the fourth floor for quiet individual work, then check the circulation desk if you need a separate room.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study floor above the library’s group-study inventory.
cards.evidence_claim: Walsh Library’s third and fourth floors are designated quiet-study floors.
cards.access_notes: Located within Walsh Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walsh Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Walsh Library, third and fourth floors
cards.notes: Reserve a group room for a shared working session, especially when you need the wall-mounted Surface Hub for live co-creation.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative rooms equipped with 50-inch Microsoft Surface Hub 2S displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Walsh Library has Microsoft Surface Hub 2S devices in 25 group study rooms on the third and fourth floors.
cards.access_notes: Book a study room through University Libraries; room availability and reservation requirements apply.

cards.title: Walsh Library Personal Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Walsh Library
cards.notes: Borrow a personal room when an interview, test, or private work session needs a separated space from the main floors.
cards.short_summary: Individual rooms available for virtual interviews, testing, or private study.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall Libraries has personal rooms available for check-out for virtual interviews, testing, or private study time.
cards.source_title: Seton Hall Libraries: Your Partner in Research and Innovation
cards.access_notes: Personal rooms are available for check-out; confirm current availability and borrowing procedures with University Libraries.

cards.entity_name: Innovation Hub Open Lounge & Collaboration Space
cards.title: Innovation Hub Open Lounge & Collaboration Space
cards.subtitle: Teaching, Learning and Technology Center, Walsh Library ground floor
cards.notes: Use the flexible seating and power access for collaborative coursework, then keep projects moving with nearby technology support.
cards.short_summary: An open study and collaboration area with soft seating, flexible workspaces, lighting, and power.
cards.evidence_claim: The Innovation Hub’s Open Lounge & Collaboration Space offers soft seating, flexible workspaces, ambient lighting, and power access for students to study and collaborate.
cards.source_title: Innovation Hub - Technology, Making & Creative Studios at Seton Hall University
cards.access_notes: Located on Walsh Library’s ground floor. Its open-access seating and collaborative areas follow Walsh Library operating hours.

cards.entity_name: Monsignor James C. Turro Seminary Library
cards.title: Monsignor James C. Turro Seminary Library
cards.subtitle: Lewis Hall, South Orange campus
cards.notes: Sign the guestbook before using this theology-focused library, then settle in with its print collections and periodicals.
cards.short_summary: A Lewis Hall library centered on theology, Church history, liturgy, and biblical studies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monsignor James C. Turro Seminary Library is in Lewis Hall; Seton Hall undergraduate and graduate students sign a guestbook to use it.
cards.access_notes: Primary access is for seminary and University faculty; Seton Hall undergraduate and graduate students may use the library after signing a guestbook.

cards.title: Jubilee Hall Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Jubilee Hall study space and lounge area
cards.notes: Use this commuter-listed indoor study location between classes; pair it with the nearby lounge services as needed.
cards.short_summary: A designated commuter study-space and lounge-area location in Jubilee Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall lists Jubilee Hall’s second floor among study spaces and lounge areas available to commuter students.
cards.access_notes: Listed by Seton Hall as a commuter study-space and lounge-area option; verify building access at the time of your visit.

cards.title: Fahy Hall Basement
cards.subtitle: Fahy Hall study space and lounge area
cards.notes: Use this commuter-listed basement location for a practical on-campus work break, and check building access before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Seton Hall-listed indoor study-space and lounge-area option in Fahy Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall lists Fahy Hall Basement among study spaces and lounge areas available to commuter students.
cards.access_notes: Listed by Seton Hall as a commuter study-space and lounge-area option; verify building access at the time of your visit.
